**Immunohistochemistry Panel for Lung Neoplasm**  
Method: Manual / Automated IHC using DAB chromogen on FFPE tissue.

------------------------------------------------------------
IHC MARKERS AND RESULTS
------------------------------------------------------------

| Marker      | Result     | Interpretation                         |
|-------------|------------|----------------------------------------|
| TTF-1       | [Pos/Neg]  | Marker for adenocarcinoma, small cell  |
| Napsin A    | [Pos/Neg]  | Supports adenocarcinoma                |
| p40         | [Pos/Neg]  | Specific for squamous cell carcinoma   |
| p63         | [Pos/Neg]  | Squamous marker (less specific)        |
| CK7         | [Pos/Neg]  | Common in adenocarcinoma               |
| CK20        | [Pos/Neg]  | Usually negative in primary lung ca    |
| Synaptophysin | [Pos/Neg]| Neuroendocrine marker (small cell)     |
| Chromogranin | [Pos/Neg] | Neuroendocrine marker                  |
| Ki-67       | ____ %     | Proliferation index                    |

(*Additional markers as per case: CD56, EMA, ALK, ROS1, PD-L1, etc.*)

------------------------------------------------------------
INTERPRETATION
------------------------------------------------------------

[Example:]  
- IHC profile (TTF-1 and Napsin A positive; p40 negative) supports diagnosis of **lung adenocarcinoma**.  
- Neuroendocrine markers negative.  
- High Ki-67 suggests increased proliferative activity.

(*Tailor interpretation based on staining pattern.*)
